output.description: Moves a plan's lapsed-subscription export files from the active exports folder into the dated archive folder. It then locks permissions so the CSVs are read-only for owner and group (0440) and the folder is closed to others (0750), and runs the billing reconciliation script against the archived batch. Returns the archive location, the number of files moved, and the script's output.
output.declaring_phrase: locks permissions so the CSVs are read-only for owner and group (0440)
